rejected_rule.statement: The word 'owner' in section 2 (4) (c) of the Rent Act can be reasonably regarded as including a life interest holder who occupied the property on 01st January 1980.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Therefore, I am of the view that, the word 'owner' in section 2 (4) (c) of the Rent Act can be reasonably regarded as including a life interest holder who occupied the property on 01st January 1980.
